notes.title: New Season Begins in 2025! Hall of Fame Updates & Fresh Challenges Await!
notes.notes:
[b]🏆 2025 Season Starts 01.01![/b]
The 2025 season of World CHAMPIONS: Decathlon kicks off on 01.01.2025! The top players from the last season have earned their spots in the Hall of Fame, but now it's your turn to shine.

[b]What’s New This Season?[/b]

[b]Hall of Fame:[/b] The best of last season are now immortalized. Can you top their scores in the new season?
[b]Clean Slate:[/b] Start fresh with a new season and new opportunities to rise to the top. Compete in 10 exciting events!
[b]Seasonal Achievements:[/b] Earn new Steam Achievements as you compete and beat your best scores!
[b]Fresh Challenges:[/b] With each season comes a fresh set of challenges, pushing you to improve your skills and beat your own high scores.

Get ready to race, jump, throw, and vault your way to the top in the 2025 season! Prove you’ve got what it takes to be a World Champion.
